description: This PHP source file manages the user interface and scripting for configuring RIP (Routing Information Protocol) settings on a network device. It includes PHP code to initialize configuration data, HTML for the form layout, embedded JavaScript for client-side validation and interactivity, and PHP includes for header, footer, and other page components.

methods.name: saveRIP
methods.description: Saves the RIP configuration by sending an AJAX POST request to the server if the form is valid.
